_doc: Model tiers. Depth 0 = main loop (opus, decides). Depth 1 = agents spawned by the main loop: plugin agents use their own `model` frontmatter (sonnet = judgment, haiku = mechanical); built-in types use `agents` below, else the subagent_model option. Depth 2 = agents spawned by a subagent: only `leaf_agents`, always on `leaf_model`. `report_only_agents` may write files only under context/.runtime/. An explicit model on the Agent call wins at depth 1 only.
